create_lookahead_optimizer: create a lookahead optimizer wrapping SGD with sync_period=5 and slow_step_size=0.5
init_lookahead_params: initialize synchronized fast and slow lookahead parameters from initial model weights
update_lookahead_params: update lookahead parameters with fast optimizer gradients and periodic slow parameter sync
reset_lookahead_state: reset fast optimizer state after each synchronization step in lookahead optimizer
use_slow_params_for_inference: use slow lookahead parameters for evaluation and inference instead of fast parameters
